blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sliders provide an intuitive interface for continuous image editing. In current generative approaches, however, the slider is simply a rescaling of the method’s strength parameter, such as an adapter coefficient, a prompt weight, or an interpolation factor. This strength relates poorly to perceptual change. The image can partially revert as the slider moves, long stretches of the range produce no visible difference, and short intervals transform the image abruptly. Remapping the strength could fix this uneven pace, but only if the trajectory is monotone, which current methods do not enforce. We therefore distinguish the slider from the strength, and require perceptual distance from the input to grow linearly with the slider value. We introduce UniSlider, a lightweight LoRA trained on a few-step editing backbone so that its strength approximates this ideal slider. Few-step sampling lets us impose this objective in pixel space without intermediate ground truth, and the backbone’s output is preserved at full strength. However, a low-rank adapter cannot make the strength fully uniform. Our slider is thus an inference-time remapping of the strength, obtained by adaptive sampling. Since training optmizes to make the trajectory monotone, this remapping closes the remaining gap without extra training or parameters. On a new benchmark of 300 continuous edits evaluating uniformity, monotonicity, edit fidelity, and identity preservation, UniSlider outperforms all prior methods and is preferred in a user study.
blocks.zh: 滑动为连续图像编辑提供了直观的界面. 然而,在目前的基因方法中,滑动器只是方法强度参数的回放,如适配系数,即时加权或插入系数. 这种力量与观念上的变化关系不大。 图像可以随着滑动器的移动而部分回放,长的伸展范围不会产生明显的区别,而短的间隔会突然地改变图像. 重新绘制强度可以改变这种不均衡的速度,但只有轨迹是单通的,而目前的方法并不强制使用. 因此,我们将滑动器与强度区分开来,并且要求从输入的知觉距离与滑动器值线性地增长. 我们介绍UniSlider,一个轻量级的LORA, 训练了几步编辑主干线, 使其强度接近这个理想的滑行器。 很少的分步采样让我们在像素空间中将这个目标强加于没有中间地真,骨干输出被全力保存. 然而,低等适配器不能使强度完全统一. 因此,我们的滑动器是对强度的再推论,通过适应性取样获得。 由于训练选择了使轨迹单调,因此这种再映射在没有额外训练或参数的情况下会缩小所剩空白. 在300个连续编辑评估统一性、单调性、编辑忠诚性和身份保护的新基准上,UniSlider超越了所有先前的方法,在用户研究中更受青睐。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Sliders are the near-universal interface for continuous image editing. In traditional editing software, a slider behaves like a physical dial, changing the image proportionally to how far the handle moves, so the same displacement produces a comparable change anywhere in the slider range. Generative sliders inherit this interface, but most fail to match its behavior. Because the mapping from slider value to perceptual change is highly non-uniform, users may find them confusing to control.
blocks.zh: 滑动器是连续图像编辑的近乎通用的界面. 在传统的编辑软件中,滑动器的行为像一个物理拨号,按照手柄移动多远的比例来改变图像,所以同样的置换在滑动器范围的任何地方会产生相近的变化. generative slivers继承了这个接口,但大多数都未能与其行为相匹配. 由于从滑动器值到知觉变化的映射高度不统一,用户可能会发现它们难以控制.

blocks.en: Existing generative sliders depart from the expected behavior of a physical dial in two ways. The first is non-uniformity, which has two complementary symptoms: dead zones , intervals across which the image barely changes, and jumps , intervals across which the image changes far more than a small drag should imply. The second is non-monotonicity, which appears as reversals : moving the slider forward partially undoes the edit. Much of the range thus becomes unusable, leaving the user with only a few effective settings that depend on the edit.
blocks.zh: 现有的基因滑动器从物理拨号的预期行为中分出两种方式. 第一种是不一致,它有两个互补的症状:死区,图像几乎改变的间隔;和跳跃,图像改变的间隔远不止一个小拖拉应该意味着的间隔. 二是非多态性, 它以倒转形式出现 : 将滑动器向前移动, 部分取消编辑 。 因此,许多范围变得无法使用,使得用户只有几个依赖于编辑的有效设置.

blocks.en: Perceptual uniformity has not, to our knowledge, been posed as an objective for generative image-editing sliders. Prior work has focused on what the edit does, not on how changes are distributed along the range. The slider is simply a linear rescaling of the method’s internal strength parameter, inherited from whichever quantity happens to be continuous: an adapter coefficient ( Gandikota et al., 2024 ; Zarei et al., 2026 ) , a prompt weight ( Parihar et al., 2026 ; Guerrero-Viu et al., 2024 ) , or an interpolation factor ( Li et al., 2026 ; Endo et al., 2026 ) . Remapping this strength could fix non-uniformity, but only if the editing trajectory is monotone. Since the strength is typically supervised only at its endpoints, if at all, nothing enforces this. We therefore distinguish between the internal strength, which drives the edit, and the user-facing slider, whose value should grow linearly with perceptual distance from the input. Figure 2 (top row) illustrates this for SliderEdit ( Zarei et al., 2026 ) , the current state of the art. We sample images at equal steps of its strength and plot the relative perceptual change of each. An ideal slider traces the diagonal (equal steps, equal change), but SliderEdit’s curve shows a dead zone and a jump.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,概念上的统一性并不是作为基因图像编辑滑动器的目标。 之前的工作集中于编辑的内容,而不是按照范围如何分配变化. 滑动器只是该方法内部强度参数的线性回升,继承自相继的量:适配器系数(Gandikota等,2024;Zarei等,2026),即时重量(Parihar等,2026;Guerrero-Viu等,2024),或内插系数(Li等,2026;Endo等,2026). 重新绘制这种强度可以修复不相容性,但只有编辑轨迹为单调. 由于力量通常只在其终点受到监督,因此,即使没有任何东西可以强制执行这一点。 因此,我们区分内部强度,它驱动编辑,和用户造型的滑行器,其价值应该随着与输入的知觉距离而线性地增长. 图2(上行)为滑行Edit(Zarei等,2026年)说明了这一点,即目前的艺术状况。 我们以同等的强度来取出图像,并绘制每个图像的相对感知变化。 一个理想的滑行器跟踪对角(等步,等相变化),但滑行Edit的曲线显示一个死区和跳跃.

blocks.en: We introduce UniSlider, a text-based editing method with a perceptually uniform slider. We repurpose a few-step editing backbone by training a lightweight LoRA to edit an image such that the perceptual distance from the input is proportional to the given strength. Using a few-step editing backbone allows decoding to pixel space during training and imposing perceptual uniformity directly, with no ground-truth intermediate images. This alone already removes most of the dead zones and jumps, making our vanilla LoRA track the ideal perceptual diagonal far more closely ( Fig. 2 , middle row). However, the low-rank space cannot reach full uniformity on every image and editing concept. We close the remaining gap with an inference-time adaptive sampling step that remaps the strength values onto the slider shown to the user, so that equal slider steps produce near-equal perceptual change without any additional training ( Fig. 2 , bottom row). Figure 1 shows three UniSlider examples.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了UniSlider,一种以文字为基础的编辑方法,带有一种感知上统一的滑动器. 我们通过训练轻量级的LORA来重新使用几步编辑主干线来编辑一个图像,这样,与输入的感知距离就与给定的强度成正比了. 使用几步编辑主干线,可以在训练期间解码到像素空间并直接强制实施知觉统一,没有地真中间图像. 仅此一项就已经清除了大部分已死区并跳出,使得我们的香草LORA跟踪理想的知觉对角更接近(图2,中行). 然而,低等空间无法在每个图像和编辑概念上达到完全统一. 我们用一个推断时间的适应性取样步骤来缩小所剩的空白,该步骤将强度值映射到向用户显示的滑动器上,从而使等同的滑动步骤在没有任何额外训练的情况下产生接近等同的观念变化(图2,下行)。 图1显示三个UniSlider的例子。

blocks.en: Evaluating a slider quantitatively is itself challenging. Infinitely many trajectories are valid for the same edit instruction, so metrics that compare against a reference image do not apply. There is also no shared benchmark. Existing slider methods report results on small, method-specific test sets that are not publicly available, while general editing benchmarks such as PIE-Bench ( Ju et al., 2024 ) include edits with no meaningful intermediate strength, such as adding or removing an object. We address this evaluation gap by introducing a benchmark specifically designed to assess continuous image editing.
blocks.zh: 从数量上评估滑动器本身具有挑战性。 无限多的轨迹对于同一个编辑指令是有效的,因此比较参考图像的度量法不适用. 也没有共同的基准。 现有的滑行器方法报告对不公开的小型,方法特定测试集的结果,而PIE-Bench(Ju等,2024年)等一般编辑基准包括没有有意义的中间强度的编辑,例如添加或去除一个对象. 我们通过采用一个专门用于评估持续图像编辑的基准来弥补这一评价差距。

blocks.en: We summarize our contributions as threefold: • We identify and formalize perceptual uniformity as a failure mode of text-based image sliders. • We propose UniSlider, a perceptually uniform slider for continuous image editing. A lightweight LoRA is trained on top of a few-step editing backbone, optimizing a pixel-space perceptual metric so that perceptual change grows linearly with the strength value. Inference-time adaptive sampling then maps the strength to a perceptually uniform slider. • We introduce a benchmark for continuous text-based image editing, covering 300 cases in three editing categories, which evaluates uniformity jointly with edit fidelity and identity preservation. UniSlider performs consistently best across the metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们总结我们的贡献有三: 我们确定并正式确定概念统一是文本图像滑动器的失败模式。 我们提出UniSlider, 一种概念上统一的滑行器, 用于图像的持续编辑。 一个轻量级的LORA在几步编辑主干线上被训练出,优化了像素-空间感知度量,使感知变化随强度值而呈线性增长. 推论时间适应性取样,然后将强度映射到一个能感知到的统一滑动器上。 我们采用一个基于文字的连续图像编辑基准,涵盖300个案例,分为三个编辑类别,这些类别与编辑忠诚度和身份保全性共同评价统一性。 UniSlider在各种衡量标准上的表现始终是最佳的。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Sliders are attractive for editing as they provide means to dial edits up or down rather than accepting or rejecting them outright. Unfortunately, building generative sliders is challenging, due to the lack of ground-truth supervision. Existing generative sliders fall into two categories. Training-free methods expose a continuous coefficient in the inference process: classifier-free-guidance scale, semantic space interpolation, or velocity-field decomposition without any additional supervision ( Endo et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Ekin & Gandelsman, 2026 ) . This approach requires no training data, but the resulting axis is a byproduct of the diffusion sampler rather than a quantity shaped to behave predictably, and we find it the less reliable of the two categories ( Section 6 ).
blocks.zh: 滑行者对编辑很有吸引力,因为他们提供了拨号上下编辑的手段,而不是直接接受或拒绝编辑。 遗憾的是,由于缺乏对地真相的监督,建造基因滑行器具有挑战性。 现有的基因滑动器分为两类. 无培训方法暴露出推论过程中的连续系数:分类无指导尺度,语义空间插值,或速度-场分解而无需任何额外的监督(Endo等,2026;Li等,2026;Ekin和Gandersman,2026)。 这种方法不需要培训数据,但由此产生的轴是扩散取样器的副产品,而不是可以预测的行为量,我们认为这两类数据中可靠性较低(第6节)。

blocks.en: Training-based methods instead learn the strength axis, typically as a LoRA adapter scaled by a coefficient. Concept Sliders ( Gandikota et al., 2024 ) trains one adapter per concept from a small set of contrastive image pairs, targeting generation rather than editing a given input. Alchemist ( Sharma et al., 2024 ) fine-tunes a diffusion model on a synthetic dataset of rendered material variations to control object-intrinsic attributes. Kontinuous Kontext ( Parihar et al., 2026 ) takes a different route to supervision as it builds pseudo-ground-truth intermediate edits by morphing between an input and its edit with a pre-trained morphing method. Consequently, its output quality is tied to the morphing procedure, and it inherits any artifacts that procedure introduces. SliderEdit ( Zarei et al., 2026 ) trains a LoRA to cancel the edit of the base editing model, using the frozen model under a neutral instruction as a self-supervised target. In all these methods, the slider exposed to the user is simply the learned strength, linearly rescaled to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , so it inherits any non-uniformity of the strength axis.

blocks.en: Taken together, this line of work establishes that a LoRA’s scaling coefficient is a good place to expose edit strength as it is simple, requires no architecture changes, and composes with any editing backbone. However, with the partial exception of Kontinuous Kontext’s morphed trajectories, none of these methods place any requirement on what happens between the endpoints. The strength coefficient is supervised, if at all, only at its extremes, and the middle of the interpolation is left to whatever the LoRA does on its own. This is precisely the gap UniSlider targets. A broader discussion of related works is provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 本文一并证明, LORA 的缩放系数是显示编辑强度的好地方, 然而,除了康蒂尼克·康特特的形态轨迹部分例外,这些方法都没有对端点之间发生的事情提出任何要求. 强度系数被监督,如果有的话,只能处于其极端,而插值的中位则留待LORA自己做什么. 这正是UniSlider的缺口目标。 附录B对相关工作进行了更广泛的讨论。

blocks.en: 5 Benchmark
blocks.zh: 5 基准

blocks.en: Existing image editing benchmarks, such as Pie-Bench ( Ju et al., 2024 ) , primarily evaluate whether a model can perform a given edit, but are not designed to assess continuous editing across slider strengths. Other works therefore rely on small, concept-specific evaluation sets, limiting the diversity of edits and scenes considered. To address this gap, we introduce a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate continuous image editing, comprising 300 carefully curated image–instruction pairs spanning diverse scenes and editing concepts. We categorize the edits into three types: Global or Stylization , which apply a consistent change across the image; Attribute or Local , which modify a specific object or region; and Structural , which alter the image content with changes that depend on its semantics. Detailed examples of the image and instruction generation, full metric definitions and evaluation protocols are provided in the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 现有的图像编辑基准,如Pie-Bench(Ju等,2024年),主要评价一个模型是否能够进行给定的编辑,但并非旨在评估跨滑动器优势的持续编辑. 因此,其他作品依赖于针对特定概念的小型评价集,限制了所考虑的编辑和场景的多样性. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了一个专门用来评价连续图像编辑的基准,其中包括300个精心整理的图像-指示对,跨越不同的场景和编辑概念。 我们把编辑分为三种类型: Global 或 Stylization , 在整个图像中应用一致的改变; 属性或局部 , 修改特定对象或区域; 结构 , 改变图像内容, 改变取决于其语义的改变 。 《补充材料》提供了图像和教学生成、完整计量定义和评价协议的详细实例。

blocks.en: We select diverse images from the publicly available Adobe-MIT-FiveK ( Bychkovsky et al., 2011 ) dataset and curate text instructions describing edits that admit a meaningful continuous progression from the original image to the desired result. Instructions were designed to avoid inherently binary operations, such as object removal, and instead cover edits for which intermediate strengths are well-defined. We further manually curate the resulting image–instruction pairs to ensure that the requested edits are meaningful and sufficiently diverse across the three categories.
blocks.zh: 我们从公开的Adobe-MIT-FiveK(Bychkovsky等,2011年)数据集中选择了不同的图像,并整理了描述编辑的文字说明,这些说明承认了从原始图像到预期结果的有意义的持续进展。 指令设计是为了避免内在的二进制操作,例如对象去除,取而代之的是覆盖中间强项被明确界定的编辑. 我们进一步手动管理由此产生的图像-指示对等,以确保所请求的编辑具有意义,并具有充分的多样性。

blocks.en: We evaluate six properties that characterize a high-quality image editing slider: edit fidelity , identity preservation , endpoint consistency , image quality , strength monotonicity , and perceptual uniformity . Edit fidelity measures whether the requested edit is successfully performed at full strength, while identity preservation evaluates whether the original scene and unrelated content are maintained. At its lower endpoint, the slider should return the input image unchanged. We assess image quality on all generated images using a no-reference quality metric. Strength monotonicity measures violations in the progression of edit fidelity, while perceptual uniformity is measured from the variation of perceptual distances between consecutive slider outputs. We use complementary image- and VLM-based metrics for these properties. Full metric definitions, validations, examples of the metrics, and evaluation protocols are provided in Appendix E .

blocks.en: Table 1 reports all the slider methods of Section 2 on our benchmark. These methods use different editing backbones, so we normalize the comparison when possible. The training-free methods (FlowSlider, VeloEdit, DiffusionSteering) carry no dataset dependency, and we reimplement them on Flux.2-Klein-4B, the same backbone UniSlider uses. Kontinuous Kontext and SliderEdit are tied to their own training data, which is not publicly available, so we report them on Flux.1-Kontext as published. For SliderEdit, we additionally retrain it on our training set with the Flux.2-Klein-4B backbone (see Appendix E ). We also include the closed-source Firefly Tune from Adobe Firefly. UniSlider achieves the best overall performance, consistently ranking either first or second across all metrics, with the largest gains observed in monotonicity and uniformity, the two properties we identified as critical for effective sliders. Note that SliderEdit and UniSlider preserve the editing capability of the base model at full strength, while the other methods degrade it because of their formulation.

We provide further metrics in the supplementary section Appendix E .

Figure 5 shows UniSlider on three edits: a global one (turning the scene into modelling clay), a local one (making the man more excited), and a structural one (turning on the burner).
In all three cases, the intermediate steps are perceptually evenly spaced, with no dead zones or jumps.

blocks.en: Figure 6 combines a masked edit with a global one in a 2D grid. The horizontal axis applies a masked edit restricted to the blue car (the masked region is shown in red in the first cell), while the vertical axis applies a global stylization to the whole scene. We obtain the second axis by composition. We run a forward pass with the first instruction, then feed each output back as the input for the second. UniSlider is trained on a single instruction at a time and never sees composed edits or spatial masks during training, yet the grid remains approximately uniform along both axes and the two edits remain largely independent, moving along one axis neither undoes nor amplifies the other. blocks.en: UniSlider relies on a perceptual distance D ⁡ ( ⋅ , ⋅ ) D(\cdot,\cdot) to define perceptual uniformity and to train for it. We therefore examine three questions: (i) whether perceptual distances track how humans judge the magnitude of an edit, (ii) how much the choice of D D matters for training, and (iii) whether supervising intermediate strengths is necessary or constraining the endpoints alone is enough.
blocks.zh: UniSlider依赖于感知距离 D Q (⋅, ⋅) D(\cdot,\cdot)来定义感知统一性并为它训练. 因此,我们审查三个问题:(一) 知觉距离是否跟踪人类如何判断编辑的大小;(二) DD的选择对培训有多重要;(三) 监督中间优势是否必要或仅限制终点是否足够。

blocks.en: (i) Learned perceptual metrics are trained to judge which of two concepts is closer to a reference ( Fu et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , but our method needs D D to measure the magnitude (e.g. be calibrated) of an edit, comparably across edit types. To validate our intended use, we designed a 2AFC study. 15 annotators saw an input image and two edits of it, made with different instructions that represented different strengths, and chose the one that changed more. We correlate the aggregated choices by Bradley–Terry ( Bradley & Terry, 1952 ) with each metric’s distance to the input ( Table 3 , first two columns). PLCC is the key measure, since uniformity requires D D to scale linearly with perceived change. Perceptual metrics correlate best (PLCC 0.81 0.81 – 0.86 0.86 , highest for DreamSim and TPIPS), while pixel RMSE ( 0.74 0.74 ) and a color histogram ( 0.51 0.51 ) lag. This proves that perceptual metrics are a good proxy for measuring strength, specially when compared to pixel-wise metrics.
blocks.zh: (一) 所学的能见度衡量标准经过培训,可以判断两个概念中哪一个更接近于参考(Fu等,2023;Wang等,2026),但我们的方法需要DD来衡量编辑的大小(如校正),在编辑类型上可以比较。 为了验证我们的预期用途,我们设计了2AFC研究. 15个注释员看到了一个输入图像并进行了两个编辑,制作时采用了不同指示,代表了不同的长处,并选择了更多变化的. Bradley – Terry(Bradley & Terry, 1952年)的汇总选择与每个公尺的距离与输入(表3,前两栏)相关。 PLCC是关键衡量标准,因为统一性要求DD随着感知到的变化而线性地缩放. 概念度量最相关(PLCC 0.81 0.81 – 0.86 0.86,DreamSim和TPIPS最高),而像素 RMSE (0.74 0.74)和色直方图(0.51 0.51)相差. 这证明了知觉度量衡是测量强度的好代名词,尤其是与像素度度量比较时.

blocks.en: (ii) We ablate the choice of D ⁡ ( ⋅ , ⋅ ) D(\cdot,\cdot) by replacing it in both the training objective ( Eq. 4 ) and the adaptive sampling, leaving everything else fixed. The last two columns of Table 3 show the results. DreamSim performs best in both endpoint consistency and monotonicity, followed closely by the other perceptual metrics. Pixel-space RMSE and color-histogram distance fall clearly behind, with three to four times larger error at s = 0 s=0 . We therefore use DreamSim throughout the paper, as it performs best while being efficient.

blocks.en: (iii) We train a variant of our model supervised only at the lower endpoint. Mathematically, this corresponds to minimizing ℒ = D ⁡ ( x src , x s = 0 ) \mathcal{L}=D(x_{\mathrm{src}},x_{s=0}) , ensuring that the lower endpoint of the slider represents the unedited image. Consequently, the intermediate edit strengths remain unconstrained. This variant does not produce a uniform slider, even when combined with the adaptive sampling at inference. Quantitatively, the produced slider is worse by a factor of 3 3 in monotonicity and uniformity. This drop is caused because while the endpoints pin the ends of the trajectory, they say nothing about how it is traversed in between, which isolates the contribution of the uniformity term.
blocks.zh: (三) 我们只在下端点培训我们模型的变体。 在数学上,这相当于最小化L=D → (x src,x s=0)\mathcal{L}=D(x_{\ mathrm{src}},x_{s=0}),确保滑行器的下端代表未经编辑的图像. 因此,中间编辑优势仍然不受限制。 这种变体即使与推论时的适应性采样相结合,也不会产生统一的滑行器. 从数量上看,所生产的滑行器在单调和统一性上比相差3个系数. 造成这种下降的原因是,虽然终点将轨迹的尽头钉住,但他们却对它如何相互穿行却一言不发,从而孤立了统一术语的贡献。

blocks.en:
Table 3 applies our adaptive sampling to other sliders to isolate the contributions of training and remapping.
Under DreamSim, the metric used for sampling, remapping improves the uniformity of every method, bringing SliderEdit to the level of UniSlider without remapping.
Under TPIPS, which is used in neither training nor sampling, the gain shrinks for the baselines, whereas UniSlider still improves by 9%.
Remapping can only equalize a trajectory that is already smooth and monotone, and SliderEdit’s is not. Its 𝒱 VQA \mathcal{V}_{\text{VQA}} increases by 34%, because remapping concentrates samples where the change is fastest, which is precisely where the trajectory doubles back.
For UniSlider, whose trajectory is optimized to be monotone and uniform, the same procedure instead reduces 𝒱 VQA \mathcal{V}_{\text{VQA}} by 13%.
Training and adaptive sampling are therefore complementary. UniSlider without remapping already matches or outperforms every baseline with remapping, and combining both is best overall.
Further analysis and additional ablations are reported in Appendices G and H , respectively.

表3将我们的适应性取样应用于其他滑动器,以隔离培训和再绘图的贡献。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We have shown that generative editing sliders are not perceptually uniform, and that this is largely a matter of how the strength is parameterized rather than of what the base model can generate.
UniSlider separates the slider exposed to the user from the strength that drives the edit. It trains a lightweight LoRA with a pixel-space perceptual objective so that its strength approximates a perceptually uniform slider, and remaps the strength at inference time to recover the uniformity a low-rank adapter cannot represent on its own.
The result is a slider whose value has the same meaning across images and edits, as confirmed by our benchmark, which measures uniformity jointly with edit fidelity and identity preservation.
blocks.zh:
我们已经表明,基因编辑滑动器在观念上并不统一,这主要是如何将强度参数化的问题,而不是基础模型能够产生什么.
UniSlider将接触用户的滑动器与驱动编辑的强度相分离. 它训练有像素-空间感知目标的轻量级LORA,使其强度接近于能感知到的统一滑行器,并重现推断出恢复统一性的强度,低等适配器本身无法代表.
结果是一个滑动器,其价值在图像和编辑中具有同样的意义,正如我们的基准所证实的,它与编辑忠诚性和身份保护共同衡量统一性。

blocks.en: UniSlider is bounded by its editing backbone as the slider interpolates towards the backbone’s default output, so any misinterpreted instruction or artifact is carried along the whole trajectory. Likewise, UniSlider aims to be uniform under D D rather than under human perception. Our user study shows that current metrics are a good proxy, but not a perfect one. Adaptive sampling, limited by a fixed rendering budget, approaches uniformity under D D without reaching it exactly. See Appendix C for further details. Training an editing model whose strength is perceptually uniform by design, removing the need for remapping, is a natural next step.
blocks.zh: UniSlider 以它的编辑主干线为界,因为滑行器向主干线的默认输出插出,所以任何被误解的指令或文物都沿着整个轨迹来携带. 同样地,UniSlider的目的是在D D下统一,而不是在人类的认知下统一. 我们的用户研究表明,目前的衡量标准是一个很好的代名词,但不是完美的代名词. 适应性取样受到固定的提供预算的限制,在DD下接近统一,但没有达到准确的一致。 见附录 详见C. 训练一种编辑模型,其强度通过设计在概念上是统一的,消除了再映射的需要,这是自然的下一步.

blocks.en: Section 2 covers slider methods for continuous image editing. Due to space constraints, we extend that discussion here with the broader trends in text-based image editing that our backbone builds on, and with interactive editing paradigms that give users control along axes other than strength.
blocks.zh: 第2节涵盖连续图像编辑的滑动方法. 由于篇幅有限,我们在此展开讨论,阐述我们的主干网所依赖的基于文本的图像编辑的更广泛趋势,并介绍互动的编辑范式,这些范式使用户能够控制除实力以外的轴心。

blocks.en: Early text-driven editors operated by inverting a real image into a pretrained diffusion model’s noise space and then manipulating the generation process directly through cross-attention injection ( Hertz et al., 2023 ) , partial re-noising and re-denoising ( Meng et al., 2022 ) , or latent optimization ( Kawar et al., 2023 ) . These methods require no editing-specific training data and can be strikingly precise, but each edit costs a fresh inversion and often per-image optimization, and the target has to be specified as a new caption or embedding rather than a direct instruction. Instruction-tuned editors removed this overhead by training a single feed-forward model on (image, instruction, edited image) triples: InstructPix2Pix ( Brooks et al., 2023 ) bootstrapped such a dataset from GPT-3 and Prompt-to-Prompt, MagicBrush ( Zhang et al., 2023a ) replaced synthetic triples with human-annotated ones and added multi-turn edits, and Emu Edit ( Sheynin et al., 2024 ) scaled this recipe across a wide range of edit types with task embeddings. These editors generalize well and require only a single instruction at inference, but still rely on a many-step diffusion sampler, and expose no notion of edit strength: the model produces one edit, not a family of them. The most recent instruction-based editors move this recipe onto rectified-flow diffusion transformers with few-step distillation ( Labs et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) , which is what makes decoding to pixel space inside the training loop (central to our method, Section 3 ) affordable in the first place.
blocks.zh: 早期由文字驱动编辑器操作,将真实的图像倒入预先训练的传播模型的噪声空间,然后通过交叉注注来直接操纵生成过程(Hertz等,2023年),部分重点和再去名(Meng等,2022年),或潜在优化(Kawar等,2023年). 这些方法不需要编辑特定的培训数据,并且可以非常精确,但每次编辑都花费了一款新的倒行本,而且常常是逐一优化,目标必须被指定为一款新的字幕或嵌入而并非直接指令. 指令调试编辑器通过在三重(图像、指令、编辑图像)上培训单一的向导模型来删除这一间接费用: 指使Pix2Pix(Brooks等,2023年)从GPT-3和即时到Prompt中将这样的数据集拖出,MagicBrush(Zhang等,2023年a)将合成三重体取而代之,并增加了多回转编辑,而Emu Edit(Sheynin等,2024年)将这个食谱在广泛的编辑类型上进行了分级,并带有任务嵌入. 这些编辑们概括得很好,在推论上只需要一个单一的指令,但仍然依赖于一个多步骤的传播取样器,并暴露出没有编辑强度的概念:模型产生一个编辑,而不是其中的一个家族. 最新的基于指令的编辑器将这个食谱移动到经过几步蒸馏的正流扩散变压器上(Labs等,2025;Wu等,2025),这使得在训练回路(以我们的方法为中心,第3节)内对像素空间的解码首先可以负担得起。

blocks.en: A separate line of work gives users control over where or how an edit happens, rather than only what it is. Spatial conditioning methods such as ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) or OminiControl ( Tan et al., 2025 ) let a user supply a sketch, edge map, or depth map alongside the prompt. Mask-based editors ( Avrahami et al., 2022 ; Lugmayr et al., 2022 ; Sartor et al., 2026 ) instead let the user restrict an edit to a region, leaving the rest of the image untouched; UniSlider extends this idea to a soft mask rather than a binary one to control the locality of an edit. Point-based editing takes this further. DragGAN ( Pan et al., 2023 ) and DragDiffusion ( Shi et al., 2024 ) let a user drag a handle point on an image toward a target location. Other work gives the user control over scene attributes directly such as the exact color ( Butt et al., 2026 ) or material ( Baykal et al., 2026 ) of an object, or which object appears at all ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Together these give the user control over the location, geometry, and attributes of an edit. None of them, however, address its magnitude. Once a region, a point, or an attribute value is fixed, the edit is still applied all-or-nothing. This is the axis sliders operate on, and where UniSlider is positioned (see Section 2 )
blocks.zh: 单独的一行工作让用户可以控制编辑在哪里或如何发生,而不仅仅是它是什么. It requires only the ability to render at an arbitrary strength and a distance with which to measure, so it applies to any continuous editor, and we show in Section 6 that it also improves the baselines. The overhead is negligible in practice. Because it samples the trajectory densely, this reference closely approximates the exact remapping. Figure 8 compares both on one edit. The blue curve shows adaptive sampling with only 11 renders, and the solid red curve shows the frames rendered by the dense reference at each u k u_{k} . Adaptive sampling brings the curve much closer to the diagonal, and the dense reference matches it almost exactly. Each sampled photograph is first described neutrally and screened for content sufficiency: blank walls, plain sky, water surfaces and abstract textures are discarded, since they offer nothing an edit can act on. Surviving images are paired with a concept seed sampled from a fixed pool of 500 500 seeds spanning art medium, artist style, cinematic and videogame looks, color tone and art movement (global); person and object attributes; and count increase, addition or resizing, atmosphere, vegetation and urban density (structural). blocks.en: Appendix E Further benchmark details
blocks.zh: 附录E 进一步基准细节

blocks.en:
Current slider methods are evaluated on small, method-specific test sets that make cross-paper comparison unreliable. Kontinuous Kontext ( Parihar et al., 2026 ) evaluates on a held-out split of its own morphing dataset, which is unfair to methods that were not trained on that kind of data. SliderEdit ( Zarei et al., 2026 ) builds a facial-editing benchmark, which is too domain-specific to say anything about performance elsewhere. Neither benchmark is public. The alternative some methods take is to reuse an existing image-editing benchmark: FlowSlider ( Endo et al., 2026 ) and VeloEdit ( Li et al., 2026 ) both draw images from PIE-Bench ( Ju et al., 2024 ) , but PIE-Bench targets one-shot edits and includes operations such as object removal or addition that have no meaningful intermediate strength as an object is either there or it is not. Reusing it for a slider benchmark inherits that mismatch.
A further, more practical problem cuts across all of these: training-free methods are steered by a pair of prompts (positive and negative), while trained sliders take a single instruction, so any shared benchmark has to supply both prompt formats for every example or silently favor one family of methods over the other.
No existing benchmark does this.
Together these gaps (small and non-public test sets, evaluation domains too narrow to generalize from, and a benchmark format built for a different kind of edit) are why we build a dedicated benchmark for continuous image editing.
blocks.zh:
目前的滑动方法在小型的,方法特定的测试集上进行评估,使得相纸比较不可靠. Kontiniving Kontext(Parihar等,2026年)评价自己形态数据集被搁置的分出,这对没有受过此类数据培训的方法不公平. SliderEdit(Zarei等,2026年)构建了面部编辑基准,该基准过于专有域,无法在别处说任何关于性能的内容. 两个基准都不公开。 某些方法的替代办法是再利用现有的图像编辑基准:FlowSlider(Endo等,2026年)和VeloEdit(Li等,2026年)均从PIE-Bench(Ju等,2024年)中取出图像,但PIE-Bench瞄准一发编辑,包括物体去除或添加等操作,作为物体没有有意义的中间强度或者没有. 为滑动基准重用它继承了这种不匹配.

blocks.en: A benchmark for continuous editing needs to characterize six properties, and we group the metrics accordingly:
blocks.zh: 持续编辑的基准需要描述6个属性,我们据此对衡量标准进行分类:

blocks.en: • Edit fidelity. Does the intended edit happen? • Identity preservation. Is everything else preserved? • Endpoint consistency. Does the slider return the input unchanged at its minimum setting? • Image quality. Are the output images free of degradation? • Strength monotonicity. Does the slider move consistently in one direction? • Perceptual uniformity. Are its increments perceptually even? None of these six questions has a single correct answer. A continuous edit has no ground truth as infinitely many intermediate trajectories satisfy the same instruction at the same strength, and no reference image exists to compare against. This is why every metric used is either no-reference or judges a property directly from the pair of images or the trajectory itself, rather than measuring distance to a fixed target the way conventional image editing benchmarks do. With these six questions in hand, we now define the metrics used for each.
blocks.zh: • 编辑忠诚。 是否要编辑? • 身份保护。 其他东西都保存好了吗? • 终点的一致性。 滑动器在最小设置时返回输入是否不变 ? • 图像质量。 输出图像是否没有退化? • 力量单一。 滑动器是否一致地朝一个方向移动? • 观念上的统一。 其增量在观念上是否均匀? 这六个问题没有一个答案是正确的。 连续编辑没有地底真理,因为无限多的中间轨迹以同样的强度满足了相同的指令,没有参考图像可以比较. 正因为如此,所使用的每个衡量标准要么是不参考的,要么是从成对图像或轨迹本身直接判断出一个属性,而不是像常规图像编辑基准那样测量到固定目标的距离。 有了这六个问题,我们现在就确定了每个问题所用的衡量标准。

Similarly to Kumari et al. blocks.en: The original work adapts FLUX.1-Kontext and Qwen-Image-Edit. To separate the contribution of the slider formulation from that of the backbone, we retrain it on FLUX.2-Klein-4B, the same base model, training set and schedule used by our method. We keep the published hyper-parameters: rank- 16 16 LoRA ( 3.9 3.9 M parameters) on the eight attention projections ( W q , W k , W v , W o W_{q},W_{k},W_{v},W_{o} and their context counterparts), learning rate 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 , and 1000 1000 optimisation steps at an effective batch size of 6 6 , trained in about one hour on a single NVIDIA A40 80GB GPU. Three changes follow from the backbone and the evaluation protocol. First, FLUX.2-Klein-4B is not guidance-distilled, so the guidance scale of 3.5 3.5 used for FLUX.1-Kontext has no corresponding input and is omitted. Second, Klein encodes prompts without pooled projections and assembles latents through a different packing path, so the conditioning tensors are rebuilt accordingly while playing identical roles in the loss. Third, the reference implementation center-crops inputs to 1024 2 1024^{2} so that a batch can be stacked; because our benchmark requires the input aspect ratio to be preserved and our training images are of mixed orientation, we instead train at batch size 1 1 with gradient accumulation 6 6 on aspect-preserving resizes, which keeps the effective batch unchanged while avoiding a train/test mismatch in field of view.

blocks.en: Table 4 reports the benchmark results separated by edit type. Here we also include our own implementation of SliderEdit on Flux-Klein-4B ( K ), which shares the backbone with UniSlider and therefore returns the same image at full strength. blocks.en: We ran a two-alternative forced-choice (2AFC) study comparing the seven methods. On each trial, a participant saw two full 11 11 -frame strips of the same example, produced by two different methods, with method identities hidden, and left/right position randomised. Participants were asked to evaluate the results by answering two questions: which slider is better overall and which slider strip is more evenly spread. The latter measures the property central to this work, while the former is left deliberately unconstrained, so that a method winning on uniformity alone cannot also claim general preference by construction. In total, 25 25 participants contributed 881 881 pairwise judgments.
blocks.zh: 我们做了一个两个备选的强制选择(2AFC)研究,比较了七个方法. 在每次试验中,一名参与者都看到两个完全11-11-框架的同一种例子,由两种不同方法制成,方法身份被隐藏,左/右位置被随机排列. 与会者被要求通过回答两个问题来评估结果:哪一个滑道总体上比较好,哪个滑道条的分布比较均匀. 后者衡量这项工作的核心财产,而前者则故意不受限制,因此单靠统一性而取胜的方法也不能通过建筑要求普遍偏好。 共有25名参与者提供了881 881项对等判决。

blocks.en: Learned perceptual metrics such as DreamSim ( Fu et al., 2023 ) and TPIPS ( Wang et al., 2026 ) are trained on relative human judgments. Annotators are shown two candidates and a reference and asked which candidate is closer, never by how much. Their values are therefore calibrated for ranking, and nothing in their training guarantees that a distance twice as large corresponds to a change that looks twice as big. Perceptual uniformity requires precisely that, so we validate it directly with a user study.
blocks.zh: 诸如DreamSim(Fu等,2023年)和TPIPS(Wang等,2026年)等学习的认知度量衡都接受了相对人文判断的培训. 向注释者介绍两名候选人和推荐人,并询问哪个候选人更接近,从不考虑多少。 因此,他们的价值观被校准为排名,在他们的训练中,没有任何东西能保证相差两倍于相差一倍的变化。 概念上的统一性恰恰需要这样,所以我们直接通过用户研究来验证.

blocks.en: Every uniformity measure in this paper rests on a perceptual distance D D , so we check that D D agrees with people when measuring strength before using it to score methods. We built 15 15 scenes, each with a concept (e.g. “make it winter” ) rendered at four prompt-specified magnitudes from subtle to very strong, and collected 538 538 two-alternative forced-choice judgements. We show the original image and two edits and ask: "which edit changed the image more?". For each observer, nine pairs were repeated to measure self-consistency, and discard the observers that voted differently in duplicated pairs. Figure 11 (right) shows two of the 15 examples.
blocks.zh: 本文中的每一个统一度量都基于一个能感知到的距离D D,所以我们检查D在用它来计分方法之前,在测量强度时是否与人们一致. 我们建造了15个15个场景,每个场景都有一个概念(例如“使它变得冬天”),从微妙到非常强烈的4个迅速具体化的场景,并收集了538 538个两个备选的强迫选择判决。 我们显示原始图像和两个编辑,然后问:"哪个编辑更改变了图像?". 对于每个观察者,重复了9对,以衡量自我一致性,并抛弃了对重复对等投不同票的观察者. 图11(右)显示15个例子中的2个。

blocks.en:
We recover a Bradley–Terry scale per scene from these judgments and correlate it with each metric’s distance to the input, reporting both Pearson (PLCC) and Spearman (SRCC) correlations in Table 3 .
SRCC measures whether a metric orders edits as humans do, while PLCC measures whether its values scale linearly with perceived change, which is what perceptual uniformity requires.
DreamSim and TPIPS agree best with human judgments and are effectively tied, followed by LPIPS and CLIP .
Pixel-space RMSE is clearly behind and a color-histogram distance further still.
For every metric PLCC and SRCC are within 0.01 0.01 of each other, so the metrics that rank edits correctly also scale close to linearly with perceived magnitude, which is what justifies using D D as a measure of strength rather than only as a ranking signal. See Figure 11 (left) for a plot of the results.

SRCC衡量一个度量令是否像人类一样编辑,而PLCC衡量其值是否随感知的变化而线性地缩放,这就是感知上的统一要求.

blocks.en:
The top block of Table 6 reports UniSlider trained on different base editing models: a distilled Qwen-Image-Edit, an 8-step distilled FireRed-1.0-Edit, and Flux.2-Klein at both 4B and 9B.
All four reach comparable edit fidelity and identity preservation, which is expected since these are largely inherited from the backbone at full strength.
The differences appear in the slider-specific properties.
Both Flux-Klein models are clearly ahead on monotonicity and uniformity, while FireRed-1.0 is the weakest and also fails to return the input at zero strength.
We attribute this to its eight-step schedule. The objective is imposed on decoded pixels, so the gradient is backpropagated through twice as many sampling steps as for the four-step models, which makes the optimization considerably harder.
blocks.zh:
表6的上行报告UniSlider接受了不同基底编辑模型的培训:一款蒸馏出Qwen-Image-Edit,一款8步蒸馏出FireRed-1.0-Edit,一款Flux.2-Klein同时在4B和9B.
所有这四个组织都达到可比的编辑忠诚度和身份保存率,这是预期的,因为这些组织基本上完全从骨干继承。
差异出现在滑动器特定属性中.
Flux-Klein两种模式在单调性和统一性上明显领先,而FireRed-1.0则是最弱的,也未能以零强度还原输入.
我们将此归因于它的八步时间表。 目标被强制于已解码的像素上,因此梯度通过比四步模型多一倍的采样步骤来回传播,这使得优化更加困难.

blocks.en:
We adopt Flux-Klein-4B for UniSlider.
Flux-Klein-9B is slightly better on edit fidelity and image quality, but it is worse on uniformity, the property we optimize for, while being twice as large and twice as slow. At 8 8 B parameters and 7.2 7.2 s for 11 11 frames, Flux-Klein-4B is also the most efficient of the four, generating a full slider four times faster than Qwen-Image-Edit and nine times faster than FireRed-1.0.
blocks.zh:
我们为UniSlider采用Flux-Klein-4B.
Flux-Klein-9B在编辑忠诚度和图像质量方面略好一些,但在统一性方面则更差,是我们优化的地产,同时是两倍大和两倍慢. 在8个8 B参数和7.2 7.2 s为11个相框,Flux-Klein-4B也是4个相框中效率最高的,产生出一个全滑道比Quen-Image-Edit快4倍,比FireRed-1.0快9倍.

blocks.en:
The bottom block of Table 6 sweeps the adapter rank r ∈ { 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 } r\in\{4,8,16,32\} on Flux-Klein-4B.
Edit fidelity and identity preservation are unchanged across the sweep, and uniformity improves only marginally with rank, with no measurable cost in inference time.
This is consistent with the capacity analysis of Section 4 . Rank governs how many image–instruction pairs the adapter can hold a uniform trajectory for, but on the full dataset the residual non-uniformity is recovered by adaptive sampling rather than by additional capacity.
We use r = 32 r=32 throughout, as it is best on every metric at a cost of 7.9 7.9 M trainable parameters, under 0.1 % 0.1\% of the backbone.

表6的下方块将适配器排行 r { 4, 8, 16, 32} r\\ n4, 8, 16, 32} 在 Flux-Klein-4B上.
在整个清理过程中,编辑忠诚度和身份保全度没有变化,统一性仅略有提高,没有可计量的费用推断时间。
这符合第4节的能力分析。 排名决定了适配器可持有统一轨迹的图像-指令对数,但在完整的数据集上,剩余不一致性通过适应性取样而不是通过额外能力得到恢复。
我们使用 r = 32 r = 32 整个过程,因为它是每个度量的最好方法,成本为 7.9 7.9 M 可训练参数,低于主干线的0.1%.
